text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the crucial moment is almost here! 
Who will make the first move!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Heeere I gooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This week's big moment is... RIGHT HERE!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (――It's here!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Kiseki-san, if you were gonna make a 
move, I figured it'd be when the race was 
gettin' the most interestin'...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm the one who's gonna take the win, 
yeahhh!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAHH!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac breaks through!!! It's Lucky 
Lilac!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac----!! Crossing the finish line 
in the lead!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An awakened run! Her evolution since the 
Classic Class just doesn't stop!! 
Brilliant, Lucky Lilac!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright!! That was a complete and 
undeniable victory for me!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks a bunch, Hanshin Racecourse! You 
really are my beloved home turf!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And... I've finally got it in my 
hands...!! The ticket along the road to 
the "Queen's" revival...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-So strong~~!! Was Lucky Lilac always 
this incredible...!? I mean, I knew she 
was strong, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She went toe-to-toe with Almond Eye, so 
that definitely wasn't just for show...! 
She's top-class even in the Senior 
tier...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh!! It frustrates me, but that's my 
total defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Lala's run today was amazing...! Just 
thinking back on it makes my whole body 
tremble...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that. Thank you 
kindly for today.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! They completely pulled off an 
awakening across a two-page spread...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Kiseki runs with all her might. Yet, 
burning within Lala's stride was a passion 
far hotter than anything Kiseki could have 
imagined...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's so frustrating...! Lara-chan, 
you were just way too cool...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Praisin' me like that's makin' me 
kinda blush, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm still in the middle of 
making my comeback—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san completely turned my world upside 
down, and I'm only just barely getting 
back on my feet."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Lala-chan—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Whatever history there was between 
Lala-chan and Ai-chan... I might not know 
the whole story, but—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As a reader today, I became certain. That 
script is without a doubt thrilling and 
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-san—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I mean, yeah, the stories Ai-chan draws 
are super classic, passionate... like the 
kind of manga that becomes a national 
sensation.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's no rule saying a story has 
to be conventional to be interesting! The 
world is full of amazing stories that 
people love!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Lala-chan's story is packed full of her 
struggles too, and that unique, fiery 
passion of hers is bound to be loved!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You have to finish writing that story!! I 
just know it'll be amazing enough to rival 
Ai-chan's story...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"And next time, I'll bring an even more 
fascinating story to the table and clash 
with you, Lala-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-san...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you, truly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes again, I'll face you 
head-on with everything I've got, just 
like always."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Take pride in our story.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac brilliantly conquered 
the Osaka Hai, making a massive statement 
to the racing world...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. At the meeting to decide on 
target races after the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Setting the Victoria Mile as the 
nearest target race—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I talked a bit 
about the future today?
choice_data_list: Of course. Tell me what you're thinking.
Of course. Let me hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to you, I won the Osaka Hai and 
held my own charging against formidable 
rivals like Kiseki-san. However—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now, as a Tiara Umamusume, I dare to once 
again seek to claim the title of 'Queen.'

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"For that to happen, after running the 
Victoria Mile—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn, please let me run in the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The Victoria Mile is the race held in 
spring to determine the strongest miler 
among the Senior-class Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup, on the other 
hand, is held in autumn to determine the 
strongest medium-distance Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Winning both of these races... That is 
the proof of being the strongest Tiara 
Umamusume of this era...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...What I want to gain from these two 
races. That is the undeniable title of 
'Queen'. And that pride."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And in turn, that feeling of 'I'm 
invincible' that I had when I was the 
Junior-tier queen—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I want to get back to my roots.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"To me, being the 'Queen' isn't something 
decided by other people's opinions."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What's important is that I believe, more 
than anyone else, that I am the "Queen"—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The moment of victory at the Hanshin JF. 
That very instant of becoming the Junior 
Class "Queen".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That fearless feeling when I could puff 
out my chest and say, 'I'm the invincible 
queen!'—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
By becoming the 'Queen' of the Senior 
Year, I wanna bring that feeling back once 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—That is the reason I am aiming for the 
Victoria Mile and the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup now.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?
choice_data_list: I think that's the path that suits you.

I think that path is very true to who you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There could be no path more fitting for 
Lucky Lilac to become the 'Queen' in both 
name and reality...!"
choice_data_list: First up is the Victoria Mile!
First up is the Victoria Mile, right!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling you would say that, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let's go claim it—the pride of a "Queen"!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I will definitely make my 
comeback.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill the revival of the "Queen." The 
next stage is the spring tiara festival— 
the Victoria Mile.
